retrieval_policy.allowed_later_retrieval: A separately authorized later job may retrieve publicly accessible material whose terms permit use.
prohibited_retrieval: Authenticated or access-controlled content without explicit authorization
Secrets, hidden graders, sealed references, or another learner's files
on_retrieval: Record the final URL, retrieval provenance, content hash, license or terms, and validation label
Store content only in the authorized course-material area
Inspect actual scope before creating or promoting any unit
Keep unavailable dependencies blocked rather than substituting guessed content
retrieval_policy.learner_view_rule: Expose only material classified as learner-safe; never expose examiner-only content.
retrieval_policy.failure_mode: Fail closed: preserve the link record and blocked reason without claiming availability.
